title: readSTEP
body:
## readSTEP

Imports exactly one solid from a single-file STEP document with gmsh.model.occ.importShapes, converting its length unit to millimetres. Choose it to mesh a real CAD part, such as a FreeCAD STEP artifact in a workflow. The file bytes are captured (digest and retained copy) before meshing, and the volume and bounds measured by OpenCASCADE become the reference for verification. Feature history and STEP labels are not imported; name faces with the tetrahedral faceGroups.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The path must be absolute and end in .step or .stp, with at most 16 MiB; multi-solid files and assemblies fail during meshing.
- Native acceptance covers STEP parts exported by FreeCAD (20×10×5 and 20×10×7 mm); STEP from other CAD tools has not had a Schemaxis acceptance check.

Native binding: `gmsh.model.occ.importShapes`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | Absolute path of a single-file STEP (ISO 10303-21) document containing exactly one solid. The name must end in .step or .stp (any letter case); relative paths fail planning with INVALID_RESOURCE. Before meshing, Schemaxis checks that it is a regular file of at most 16 MiB that begins with "ISO-10303-21;", records its SHA-256 digest and meshes a retained copy (source.step) in the run directory. In a workflow the path can come from an upstream CAD artifact, such as {"$artifact": "cad", "index": 0}. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | **required** |
